DOP: 2 pattha m.n. and mfn. [ S. prastha], 1. ( m.n. ) ( i ) a tableland; a level expanse; a remote or uncultivated place; Abh 607 (~o tu sānu nitthiyaṃ); 1044; — ifc see vana-; — patthā in Ee at Ja VI 558, 31* is wr for panthā ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — ( ii ) a measure of capacity ( āḷhaka); Abh 482 (āḷhako caturo ~ā); 1044; Sp 176, 11 (~o nāma nāḷimattaṃ hoti ekassa purisassa alaṃ yāpanāya); Mp V 61, 21 foll. (Māgadhakena ~ena cattāro ~ā Kosalaraṭṭhe eko ~o hoti tena ~ena cattāro ~ā āḷhakaṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) remote; secluded; Ud 43, 8* (~aṃ ca sayanāsanaṃ, Ee, Se so, but perhaps wr; Be, Ce pantaṃ); — °’- odana , m. , a pattha of boiled rice; Vin III 243, 29 (omako nāma patto ~aṃ gaṇhāti; Sp 703, 21 : ~an ti Magadhanāḷiyā upaḍḍhanāḷikodanaṃ); Ja V 387, 15* (~o nālam ayaṃ duvinnaṃ); Ap 376, 28 (ayaṃ ~o atthi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~aṃ); Ps III 238, 16 (tayo māse ~en’ eva yāpesi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee piṭṭhodaken’ eva); — °- patthapulaka , n. [pulaka 1 ], a pattha of parched grain each; Vin III 6, 22 foll. (tehi assamaṇḍalikāsu bhikkhūnaṃ ~aṃ paññattaṃ hoti, bhikkhū … ~aṃ ārāmaṃ haritvā udukkhale koṭṭetvā koṭṭetvā paribhuñjanti, Be, Ce so; Ee °-mūlakaṃ; Se °-pūlakaṃ; Sp 176, 11 : ~an ti ekamekassa bhikkhuno patthapatthapamāṇaṃ pulakaṃ); Dhp-a II 154, 2 (assavāṇijakā ~aṃ bhikkhaṃ paññāpesuṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee -mūlakaṃ; Se -pūlakaṃ); — °- pulaka , n. [pattha + pulaka 1 ], a pattha of parched grain; Vin III 6, 27 (āyasmā pan’ Ānando ~aṃ silāyaṃ pisitvā bhagavato upanāmeti, Be, Ce so; Ee -mūlakaṃ; Se -pūlakaṃ); Ja III 494, 28 (temāsaṃ ~-piṭṭhodakena yāpento, Be, Ce so; Ee patthamūlaka-; Se patthapūlakapatthodanena).
